project_context.audience: Safety engineers, compliance officers, plant managers

rules: No pure #000000 or #FFFFFF without context. Use slate for a cool, sterile, technical feel.
Color is used for FUNCTION only. 90% of the UI should be monochrome.
High contrast is mandatory for all text to ensure readability of dense safety documents.

hierarchy.citation: text-xs font-mono tracking-tight text-blue-700 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200

surface_strategy.implementation: Expose the skeleton. Dashboards and panels use solid backgrounds with 1px slate-200 borders. No soft shadows. Use sharp, clean lines. Max border-radius: 4px (rounded-sm).
surface_strategy.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: slight lift, border darkens.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Strict grid hierarchy, dense and compact spacing for data, generous padding for chat reading.
layout_and_spacing.admin_dashboard: Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Gap Strategy: Tight (gap-4). Every pixel utilized.
layout_and_spacing.chat_interface: 3-column macro layout: Sidebar (250px) | Main Chat (1fr, max-w-4xl center text) | Sources Panel (300px or drawer).
layout_and_spacing.padding_scale: Use p-4 to p-8 strictly. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.

component_guidelines.buttons: Shadcn Button. Override to rounded-sm. Strict hover states explicitly declaring text color.
component_guidelines.inputs: Shadcn Input/Select. Flat, 1px border. Focus ring must be high contrast blue.
component_guidelines.tables: Shadcn Table. Dense styling. border-collapse. Expose cell borders.
component_guidelines.chat_messages: Left-aligned for both User and AI to aid scanning. Differentiate via borders and avatars. AI messages have no background, just clean text. User messages subtle slate-100 background.
component_guidelines.citations_inline: Small mono chips integrated into paragraph text. Must use Shadcn HoverCard to show the chunk preview.
component_guidelines.sources_panel: Bento-style small rectangular cards. Badges for type (SOP/HAZOP) and source (Company/Turnstile).
component_guidelines.confidence_score: Small pill badge next to AI name (e.g., '98% Confidence' in emerald green).

interactions_and_motion.transitions: Minimalist. transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for hover states.
interactions_and_motion.loading: Use mono text 'PROCESSING...' or 'SEARCHING CORPUS...' instead of generic spinners when possible.
interactions_and_motion.accessibility: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:outline-none is mandatory on all interactive elements.

icons.style: Regular or bold weight. High legibility.

login_background.description: Abstract topographical and grid background for the login page, representing precision and data.

hero_alternative.description: High contrast industrial facility, useful for an 'about' or 'onboarding' splash screen.

logo_placeholder.description: Clean tech concentric circles logo for the top-left brand anchor.

avatar_placeholder.description: Safety worker avatar for the user profile dropdown.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for structural layouts; strictly use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Dropdowns, Dialogs, Tables, HoverCards).
Ensure the Chat UI supports real-time streaming updates gracefully without jumping layout.
Implement the Source citations as a primary feature. Inline citations must be clickable/hoverable to trigger the Shadcn HoverCard containing the source text chunk.
Never use generic card layouts for Admin panels. Use the 'Control Room' grid style: tight gaps, solid borders, utilizing screen space efficiently.
Enforce high accessibility. Forms must use Shadcn Form, Input, and Label components.
Apply fonts globally in the layout shell.
Build a separate Superadmin route layout with its own persistent Sidebar containing Documents, Web Sources, and Stats.
